what: Stand once and walk the trot and the crawl at three commanded speeds for 11 designs and three masses, one run per cell. Closed-form IK and the servo model into the actuated MuJoCo model, body free, 5 V. Gait timings and servo gains are those tuned on the 150 mm legs (not re-tuned); standing height = the height at which the leg has the placeholder knee bend. All dimensions, masses, servo figures and friction are placeholders.
